note: FNCT keeps the nc TX asters in Aster while acknowledging the segregation: "All nc TX Aster species fall into Symphyotrichum. Until consensus is reached on generic circumscription in the Asteraceae, we are following the conservative approach in maintaining all nc TX species (except Chloracantha) in the genus Aster." So the flora carries these plants under a name the 1999 edition predates, not absent.
source: Diggs, Lipscomb & O'Kennon 1999, p. 315 (Aster treatment) and the Asteraceae generic discussion

note: Gonolobus suberosus is the currently accepted name for Matelea gonocarpos; the flora treats the plants under Matelea.
source: Native Plant Society of Texas, Gonolobus suberosus (syn. Matelea gonocarpos); FNCT Matelea treatment p. 62
